description: Type the in-use rejection: deleteVolume answers HTTP 409 "Volume cannot be deleted because it is in use by one or more sandboxes (e.g. <name>)" while a sandbox still mounts the volume (observed live 2026-11-06).

traits.smithy.api#documentation: A sandbox still mounts the volume, so it cannot be deleted until that sandbox is gone (HTTP 409).

message.includes: in use by one or more sandboxes
